title: Equidistribution of Syracuse random variables and density of Collatz preimages
notes: Read 23 September 2026 for the minimum-cell formulation and conditional Proposition 3, not as an independent audit of the complete blog proof. The proposed critical exponential rate beta=1 is an unproved hypothesis. Its stated consequence is X^(1-o(1)) ancestor counts; this does not itself supply the laboratory's fixed-root reciprocal divergence. The new local unit/coarse comparison is a consequence of the already known geometric operator, not a proof of beta=1. See docs/problems/collatz_fibre_unit_comparison.md.
